description: This file defines various parameter classes and types used in FastAPI for handling request parameters, including query, path, header, cookie, body, form, and file parameters, as well as dependency and security classes.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Class representing a generic request parameter with validation and schema options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Class for path parameters, extending Param, with enforced no default value.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Class for query parameters, extending Param.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Class for header parameters, extending Param, with underscore conversion option.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Class for cookie parameters, extending Param.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Class representing request body parameters, extending FieldInfo, with media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Class for form data parameters, extending Body, with media type for URL-encoded forms.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Class for file upload parameters, extending Form, with media type for multipart form data.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Class representing a dependency injection, with scope and caching options.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Class extending Depends, adding security scopes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for parameter classes, initializing validation and schema options.
